recognize_zh: 左下那顆分葉嗜中性球的胞質中有四顆金黃色、邊緣清楚的菱形／長方形折光結晶，周圍胞質有空泡化；右側另一顆核呈摺疊狀的白血球，背景紅血球皺縮，符合 EDTA 抽血後形成的膽紅素結晶。
features: Segmented neutrophil with multiple golden-yellow, refractile rhomboid to rectangular cytoplasmic crystals
Vacuolated neutrophil cytoplasm consistent with toxic change
Adjacent leukocyte with a large folded nucleus and pale vacuolated cytoplasm (band or monocyte)
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a segmented neutrophil containing several sharply outlined, golden-yellow refractile rhomboid and rectangular crystals within vacuolated cytoplasm. An adjacent leukocyte with a large folded nucleus and vacuolated cytoplasm is present, and the background red cells show diffuse crenation artifact. Findings are consistent with bilirubin crystals in neutrophils, an in vitro EDTA-related phenomenon seen with marked hyperbilirubinemia, often in septic neonates, accompanied by toxic neutrophil changes.

ddx.vs: Cryoglobulin inclusions are pale blue to colorless and dissolve on warming, unlike golden yellow bilirubin crystals.
Hemosiderin is irregular granular brown pigment that stains with Prussian blue, not geometric refractile crystals.
Stain precipitate lies on top of cells and in the background in variable focal planes, whereas bilirubin crystals are confined to neutrophil cytoplasm.
